entries.zh: 男儿独自自强——不倚仗他人帮助而自行奋发、立身显达（谚语式短语）
entries.en: to know how to rise and prevail without another's help; a man grows strong on his own (proverb)

entries.zh: 相体知人——察知对方心肠心意、善辨人情
entries.en: to know people's hearts (coraçones); to read a person's mind and circumstances
entries.notes: 西语词尾 cora[cong/con] 存疑，汉字栏仅“相體”而音写多出“知人”两音节，取互证义。

entries.zh: 体识人情——懂得感恩、善解人情
entries.en: to know how to be grateful; to understand human feelings

entries.zh: 知心——深知他人心意
entries.en: to know the heart; to know someone's mind

entries.zh: 知一不知二——仅知其一不知其二，学问浅尝
entries.en: to know a thing but not well; to know one but not two

entries.zh: 大下会〔汉字原文如此〕——样样都会、见识广大；义待考
entries.en: to know (a thing) well; broadly expert (Chinese gloss 大下会 of uncertain reading)
entries.notes: 西语 Saber bien 明确，但汉字“大下會”为非常规搭配，释义依赖推断。

entries.zh: 洞察——明察秋毫、看透事理
entries.en: to perceive a thing clearly; to see through a matter

entries.zh: 通晓——通晓明达、无所不晓
entries.en: to understand thoroughly; to be versed in it
entries.notes: 西语词头尾部 [残] 且缩写“pdo”未展开，释义以汉字“通晓”及音写为准。

entries.zh: 通识了然——通晓明晰、能讲解说明
entries.en: to know how to explain; to comprehend and make plain

entries.zh: 通达——融会贯通、事理通达（音写附“通晓”等变体）
entries.en: thoroughly versed; to master and penetrate a subject

entries.zh: 认路——识途知路
entries.en: to know the way; to recognize the road
entries.notes: 西语词头“lexica”为残损拼写，不碍汉字“認路”之确义。

entries.zh: 仙机——天机、仙家机谋，上天隐秘之智
entries.en: wisdom of the immortals; the hidden counsel of Heaven
entries.notes: 西语词头大段残损并带 [疑:ros/fus]，音写亦残；取汉字“仙机”与可读片段 Sabiduría del cielo 互证。

entries.zh: 贤——贤明、贤者
entries.en: wise; a wise and virtuous man

entries.zh: 哲——哲人、明智
entries.en: wise; a sage or philosopher
entries.notes: 音写栏存疑（[疑:Tit/fier]），释义依汉字“哲”与西语 Sabio。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字疑作“偉/倃”与西语 Sabio 不吻合，音写残损（vy . g puide [残]），语义无从定夺。

entries.zh: 慧——聪慧、智慧
entries.en: wise; intelligent

entries.zh: 通——通达透彻、明晓事理
entries.en: to penetrate and master a subject; thoroughly knowing
entries.notes: 西语“g 200”疑为缩写或交叉引用（或 q̃ todo）未展开，释义依汉字“通”。

entries.zh: 雄——雄杰、雄才
entries.en: heroic; mighty
entries.notes: 西语词头沿上条重复且与汉字“雄”不吻合，音写 hiong 明确，取“雄”义。

entries.zh: 英——英明果决、善于治理（西语兼指明智、审慎、善政）
entries.en: outstanding, heroic; wise and prudent, of good governance
entries.notes: 音写前两词（inlami liña）污损难辨，余为“英雄/英俊”之义，释义以汉字“英”为准。

entries.zh: 鉴——明鉴、鉴察，喻审慎明辨
entries.en: a mirror; discerning and prudent; to examine and take as a mirror
entries.notes: 音写“cuay ca”两音节无可对应汉字，释义以“鑑”与西语为准。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 四栏均 [残]/[空]，仅余音写污损记号，无释义材料。
